evidence: Walked instruction.md and hireops_rules.md line by line against the frozen solution; every asked-for screen, role and flow has an implementation. SCREENS: staff get Board, Conversations, Activity (app.js:90 buildViews); candidates get a 'My applications' view listing job title, team, candidate-wording status and conversation (app.js:89, threads.js:27,52-53,138-139; index.js:171-176 uses LABELS from seed). Sign-in/out and the brief's accounts with Hireops!2026 (index.js:84-101, db.js:63-66; seed users match instruction.md:17). JOBS/CANDIDATES: recruiter-only open-job form with hiring-manager select and 1-50 places (board.js:61-81, index.js:202-214); add-candidate form, bottom of Applied, email format + case-insensitive duplicate refused at the field with typed values kept (board.js:41-60, index.js:216-233), candidate-account linkage (index.js:225,229). BOARD: six stages, one-step moves via select+Move control, reject needs reason and records rejected_from, reopen only to that stage, Hired cannot be rejected (index.js:238-265, board.js:144-158,226-232); optional drag/drop incl. drop-at-place (board.js:242,300-319); shared hand order with Up/Down persisted in positions (board.js:233-241, index.js:297-318); Interview places counted, reorder inside Interview always allowed (index.js:290-295), header shows 'Interview (n of m places)' (board.js:327). Optimistic move, put back on refusal with reason and focus kept on card controls (board.js:166-205); stale version -> 409 naming the colleague via the card's last activity line (index.js:241-245). Bulk move of 2+ selected cards in board order, all-or-nothing in one immediate transaction (index.js:274-321,339-344; board.js:277-290). Undo of own latest single/bulk move, place and rejection reason restored, refused if any card's version changed or Interview would overfill, single-use, superseded by later move (index.js:165-168,348-373; board.js:291-299). Role rules for recruiter/hiring manager/observer/candidate with 401/403/404 (index.js:73-81,121-131,257-264,326-333). Card detail with internal notes, per-person per-browser unsaved note draft (board.js:85-141, keep key includes user id app.js:39-43; index.js:376-386). ACTIVITY: every open/add/move/reject(with reason)/reopen/reorder/undo logged as readable lines (index.js:195-198,211,230,266-271,315-316,366); newest-first list with All jobs / one job filter (app.js:45-85). LIVE: SSE 'changed' after every successful write incl. read markers, client refreshes in ~300 ms and patches keyed DOM in place so open card, typed note/draft, focus and scroll survive (index.js:45-54,102-107; app.js:130-164; board.js:321-341; threads.js:36-65,145-159). CONVERSATIONS: latest 30 oldest-first scrolled to newest, earlier 30 at a time with remaining count and scroll anchoring (index.js:389-405; threads.js:84-90,160-175); arrival while scrolled up keeps place, shows 'N new messages', stays unread (threads.js:145-159,176-181); Enter sends / Shift+Enter newline, box cleared and focused after send, failure keeps text with 'not sent' (threads.js:183-201); per-person unread counts and total badge (index.js:132-139,157-162; threads.js:222; app.js:115-121); 'Seen'/'Sent' receipt on sender's latest message with observer excluded (index.js:140-156; threads.js:76-83); per-person per-conversation drafts surviving switch, reload and session end, invisible to other users on that browser (threads.js:112,124,182; app.js:34,187-195). Candidate privacy: candidate bootstrap omits notes/reasons/rejected_from/positions/others/activity; staff routes refused (index.js:171-176,376,380). RUNTIME: node /app/server.js, PORT/3000, DB-free /api/health answered before the SQLite worker (bootstrap.js:18-24,43), UI+API from one process, DB_PATH default /app/app.db, seed copied beside module and loaded once (db.js:9-10,61-62; solve.sh copies app). MEASURED CORROBORATION: hash-verified scripted golden run on the frozen bytes (raw-evidence-index entries, 0 source mismatches) passed all 20 groups covering these flows, incl. live arrival 801 ms, session-end draft resume, observer read-only, restart persistence; screenshots show Board/Conversations/Activity nav, open-job and add-candidate forms with field-level duplicate error, and the candidate applications view. Adversarial probe: a broken reference missing e.g. the Activity job filter, the candidate view, or undo would fail this row and none is missing here; a conforming alternative layout (Rejected as a separate side panel, different names/routes) is allowed by 'layout and names are yours' and does not affect this row.
